basics.description: **XdrLogRaider** — open-source Microsoft Sentinel data connector for Microsoft Defender XDR portal-internal `/apiproxy/*` audit and reporting endpoints. Deploys foundation Azure resources in your selected resource group and content (custom Log Analytics table + Data Collection Rule + Sentinel V3 content package) into your existing Sentinel-enabled workspace.

options.text: XdrLogRaider runs as a self-hosted Azure Function App in your subscription. It authenticates to the Defender XDR portal using a dedicated service account with TOTP or Passkey MFA, ingests events into custom Log Analytics tables via Data Collection Rules, and registers a Sentinel V3 content package on your existing workspace. Additional Categories are added incrementally without operator action.

elements.name: serviceAccountUpn
elements.label: Service account UPN
elements.toolTip: UPN of the Entra service account that will authenticate to Defender XDR portal. Must have appropriate read permissions across Defender XDR.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid UPN (email format).

elements.name: servicePassword
elements.toolTip: Password for the service account. Stored in Key Vault (encrypted at rest).

constraints.validationMessage: Password must be at least 8 characters.

elements.name: authMethod
elements.label: MFA method
elements.toolTip: Choose how the service account will satisfy MFA. TOTP uses a base32-encoded seed (most compatible). Passkey uses WebAuthn (more secure · requires the tenant to allow passkeys).

elements.name: totpSecret
elements.toolTip: Base32-encoded TOTP secret (e.g., 'JZ2GD6SHGY5RYRCN'). Only required when MFA method is TOTP. Get this from your authenticator app setup screen.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid base32 string (16-128 chars · A-Z/a-z and 2-7).

elements.name: passkeyPem
elements.toolTip: WebAuthn private key in PEM format (begins with '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----'). Only required when MFA method is Passkey. Generate this when registering the passkey for the service account.

constraints.validationMessage: Must be a valid PEM block (BEGIN/END headers + base64 body).

elements.name: workspaceSelector
elements.label: Log Analytics workspace (Sentinel-enabled)
elements.toolTip: Select the Log Analytics workspace where Defender_<Category>_CL custom tables and Sentinel connector content will be deployed.
